parts.name: TabsRoot
parts.description: Holds the selected value and shares it with the parts inside it.

props.name: value
props.description: The selected tab's value. Pass it with `onValueChange` to control the tabs.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The tab selected at first, when the tabs aren't controlled. Without it, or when it names no tab, the first enabled tab is selected.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the new value when a tab is selected, after the selection has landed: a handler that starts a request (the panel's content), writes what a loading question reads, or is an action that awaits, never holds the tab, the roving focus or the indicator. A controlled `value` is shown as given, so an owner that writes it late switches late; one that guesses (`guess value := next`) switches at once.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Which arrow keys move between tabs: Left and Right for `horizontal`, Up and Down for `vertical`.

dataAttributes.name: data-activation-direction
dataAttributes.description: Which way the selection last moved: `left` or `right` when horizontal, `up` or `down` when vertical, and `none` until it first moves.

parts.name: TabsList
parts.description: The `tablist` that holds the tabs. It is one Tab stop, which lands on the selected tab; the arrow keys, Home and End move between tabs.

props.name: activateOnFocus
props.description: Whether a tab is selected as soon as the arrow keys focus it. With `false`, the focused tab is selected with Enter or Space.

props.name: loopFocus
props.description: Whether the arrow keys wrap around from the last tab to the first and back.

dataAttributes.name: data-activation-direction
dataAttributes.description: Which way the selection last moved: `left`, `right`, `up`, `down`, or `none` until it first moves.

parts.name: TabsTab
parts.description: A button that selects its panel. It carries `role="tab"`, `aria-selected`, and `aria-controls` pointing at its panel while selected.

props.name: value
props.description: The value that names this tab and the panel it selects.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the tab can't be selected. It stays in the list with `aria-disabled`, is skipped by the arrow keys, and your own click and key handlers on it don't run.

dataAttributes.name: data-activation-direction
dataAttributes.description: Which way the selection last moved: `left`, `right`, `up`, `down`, or `none` until it first moves.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the tab is disabled.

parts.name: TabsPanel
parts.description: The content shown while its tab is selected, with `role="tabpanel"`, labelled by its tab. It is mounted while selected and stays mounted while it animates out.

props.name: value
props.description: The value of the tab that shows this panel.

props.name: keepMounted
props.description: Whether the panel stays in the document, with `hidden`, while its tab isn't selected.

dataAttributes.name: data-activation-direction
dataAttributes.description: Which way the selection last moved: `left`, `right`, `up`, `down`, or `none` until it first moves.

dataAttributes.name: data-ending-style
dataAttributes.description: Present while the panel animates out. It is removed when its transitions and animations finish.

dataAttributes.name: data-hidden
dataAttributes.description: Present while the panel is kept mounted but its tab isn't selected.

dataAttributes.name: data-starting-style
dataAttributes.description: Present for the first frame after the panel appears: style the state it animates in from.

parts.name: TabsIndicator
parts.description: An element that follows the selected tab. Place it inside TabsList and position it with its CSS variables. It is hidden until the selected tab has a size, and absent while no tab is selected.

dataAttributes.name: data-activation-direction
dataAttributes.description: Which way the selection last moved: `left`, `right`, `up`, `down`, or `none` until it first moves.

cssVariables.name: --active-tab-left
cssVariables.description: The selected tab's distance from the list's left padding edge, in px, including the list's scroll.

cssVariables.name: --active-tab-right
cssVariables.description: The distance from the selected tab's right edge to the end of the list's scrollable width, in px.

cssVariables.name: --active-tab-top
cssVariables.description: The selected tab's distance from the list's top padding edge, in px, including the list's scroll.

cssVariables.name: --active-tab-bottom
cssVariables.description: The distance from the selected tab's bottom edge to the end of the list's scrollable height, in px.

cssVariables.name: --active-tab-width
cssVariables.description: The selected tab's width, in px.

cssVariables.name: --active-tab-height
cssVariables.description: The selected tab's height, in px.
